events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: On this day, hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur tragically died in Las Vegas, six days after being shot in a drive-by shooting.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Remembering a true icon today. Tupac Shakur's influence on music and culture remains undeniable, even 30 years on.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Anniversary
events.blurb: It marks the day the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away in London at the age of 27 in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix. His guitar work redefined rock music and continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969 in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road Turns 57
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us the masterpiece that is 'Abbey Road'. That album cover alone is legendary. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Sending big birthday wishes to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon, still fronting The Pretenders with that unmistakable voice.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock and roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis track or solo hit?

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Turns 55
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A powerful album with a timeless message that still resonates today.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod to the world on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Original iPod Day
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. Who still has theirs?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in London in 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating over six decades of 007, from the iconic theme tunes to the unforgettable gadgets. What's your favourite Bond film?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have marked the 86th birthday of The Beatles' legend John Lennon, born in Liverpool in 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message of peace continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy icon and Monty Python star John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Turns 58
angles.copy: It's been 58 years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' upon the world. A diverse and groundbreaking double LP. What's your standout track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
events.blurb: This day marks the passing of the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury. A voice and stage presence that truly defined an era. His legacy lives on.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped, marking a pivotal moment in their evolution. A classic from start to finish.
